title: Separate Coinbase XRP collateral channels, Arc institutional rails and exchange-reserve definitions
context: Coinbase Global Exchange lists XRP as perpetual-futures margin collateral; the product applies collateral haircuts, ADQ caps and automatic collateral liquidation.
Coinbase separately offers Morpho-backed USDC loans using cbXRP on Base as collateral; this is not the same market as Global Exchange margin.
Coinbase's loan terms prohibit use of loan proceeds for trading on Coinbase, but do not establish zero downstream market effect.
Circle's Arc launch announcement lists SBI Group as a founding validator, Coinbase as exchange-access partner and Morpho as credit-layer participant. Arc is a USDC-gas network distinct from XRPL.
XRP Insights exchange-wallet totals include cold storage and wrapped-token backing reserves; CryptoQuant reserve series use different wallet universes.

decisions.rule: Store Coinbase Global Exchange XRP margin collateral and Coinbase/Morpho cbXRP loan collateral as separate product channels.
decisions.rationale: Different custody, collateral representation, market mechanics, counterparties and liquidation pathways.
decisions.admission_status: STRUCTURAL_ELIGIBILITY_ONLY; posted amount unknown; no predictive feature admitted

decisions.rule: Model Arc as a parallel Circle institutional rail with explicit SBI, Coinbase and Morpho participation; do not merge Arc activity with XRPL activity.
decisions.rationale: Arc uses USDC gas and a permissioned validator cohort; Circle USDC also has a separate XRPL deployment.
decisions.admission_status: RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH_ONLY; actual settlement flows and substitution effects unknown

decisions.rule: Preserve CryptoQuant, XRP Insights and official exchange PoR as separate time series with explicit wallet universe, snapshot date, wrapped-reserve inclusion and customer-liability scope.
decisions.rationale: XRP Insights reports Binance 2.58B and Coinbase 5.84B across public labeled wallets; these include 327.4M Binance-Peg and 151.4M cbXRP backing reserves. These figures are not directly comparable to narrower exchange reserve series or official PoR.

decisions.rule: Treat the 233.46M XRP incident and reported reserve declines as a causal hypothesis until source wallet membership, provider coverage and same-time customer liabilities are reconciled.
Keep TradRadar contract/exchange aggregation as a provider-specific series; never infer notional positioning from account ratios.
Resolve SBIC in the current ChatGPT context to Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.; preserve Social Bias Inference Corpus as a distinct research-dataset meaning.
Do not issue directional XRP probabilities until fixed-horizon outcomes, point-in-time features, walk-forward baselines, calibration and shadow evaluation pass.

Disable token rotation via workflow_dispatch inputs. Never pass credentials through event inputs or interpolate untrusted inputs into shell. Use approved secret-management interfaces; this workflow must not set secrets or dispatch deployments.
decisions.verification: Exact-head CI 41176897933 passed 344 tests plus 8 subtests; fail-closed gate 41176897925 passed with merging disabled.
